System: vapula: Runs operator goals as scheduled agent work.
Non-goals:
- no-web-ui: No browser UI; operators use the CLI and Gitea.
Concept scheduler (Scheduler): Decides when queued work runs.
  env: SCHED_TICK
  - One scheduler loop per process.
Boundaries:
- scheduler-no-api: internal/scheduler/** must not import internal/api/**. The scheduler is headless.
Flags:
- USE_NEW_SCHEDULER (scheduler, expires 2026-12-01, vap-123): Gate the v2 scheduler during rollout.
Removals:
- old-queue: internal/queue (v1 job queue) (replaced by scheduler, remove by 2026-11-15, vap-130)
